description: Use when you need a published Sideline report card, the same cards as /report-cards. Optional weekId (YYYY-wNN). Omit it for the newest published card. Returns that card and the season-to-date totals. Grades are historical. For the live weather call, use get_game.

weekId.description: Week id YYYY-wNN, for example 2026-w04. Omit for the newest published card.

name: get_report_card
title: Report card
